description: Source index for Magis Capital Partners bots, including Michael's Grok bots. The GitHub repository is the source of truth.
ground_rules: Before using a dashboard data file, read its build date first. Use generated_at when the file has that field, and build_time when the file has that field.
Read _system/portfolio/registry.json fresh. Do not hardcode tickers.
Stubs go to the Special Situations desk.
Say nothing when nothing is new.
Never post Drew's personal trades or private correspondence.
Outbound messages to people need Drew's approval.

Email is read-only. Use it only to cross-reference universe names. Label each item as a newsletter or a letter with its date, and treat it as a lead until a filing confirms it. Never surface personal brokerage mail, and do not store email content in this repo.

Bots write only inside _system/memory-hub/research-equity/. Append at most three [PROPOSED] lessons per session. Never edit _system/memory/MEMORY.md. Never create a new hub without Drew's approval. Never write the borrow-etf, diamond-creek, or spx-0dte hubs.

sources.purpose: Ranked desk output, one JSON file per desk per day at <desk>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.json. Desks: special_situations, activism, fundamentals, nol_tax_assets, tape_index, stahl, short_selling. At most 12 items; every ticker from the registry or the literal unresolved; one_number required; evidence with accession or URL; confidence filing, provider, news, or web; inputs_read carries each file's stamp. research_only true, in_base_irr false, authority none.
sources.push: A pull request on a grok/<desk>/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug> branch that touches only the brief and, if needed, the hub daily note. python _system/scripts/check_desk_briefs.py must pass. Contract: _system/data/desk_briefs/README.md. Mandates: _system/agents/DESKS.md.
constraints: One file per desk per day; a correction is a new file on a later date, never an edit to a merged one.
At most 12 items, best first; a headline of at most 160 characters; one_number on every item.
Every ticker is in _system/portfolio/registry.json holdings or watchlist, or is the literal unresolved.
No position, no size, no stance, no price target, no fraud tag.
The chat room gets a one-line pointer; the brief is the record.
